high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @techdroider, dated 21 July 2023. The tweet discusses a widespread display issue affecting multiple smartphone brands, including OnePlus, Samsung, Realme, and Vivo/IQOO. The issue is described as a "green line" that appears on the screen post-software update, spreading across devices. The tweet advises users who own affected device models to stay cautious and avoid updates until the companies address the issue. The tweet has received significant engagement, with 309 comments, 262 retweets, 2,000
